description: Reasoning Schemas & Problem-Solving Archetypes for Fraction Simplification, Arithmetic Operations, Reciprocals, Complex Fractions, and Rational Word Problems.

archetypes.name: Fraction Reduction via Greatest Common Factor (การทอนเศษส่วนอย่างต่ำด้วย ห.ร.ม.)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing both numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor reduces a fraction to canonical simplest form.
mentalModel: 1. Find the greatest common factor of the numerator and denominator.
2. Divide numerator and denominator by the GCF.
3. Verify that the resulting numerator and denominator are coprime.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / b = (a / gcd(a, b)) / (b / gcd(a, b))

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting components or reducing by an incomplete common factor.

versatileDomains.description: Simplifying chemical solution concentration ratios.
Expressing representative respondent ratios in irreducible fractions.

archetypes.name: Fraction Multiplication Across Numerators and Denominators (การคูณเศษส่วนตรงตามนิยาม)
archetypes.coreConcept: The product of fractions is computed by multiplying numerators straight across and multiplying denominators straight across.
mentalModel: 1. Multiply numerators together: a * c.
2. Multiply denominators together: b * d.
3. Reduce the resulting fraction product to lowest terms.

cognitiveTraps.description: Cross-multiplying numerators and denominators when multiplying rather than dividing.

versatileDomains.description: Scaling photovoltaic power yield across chained efficiency losses.
Scaling ingredient mass fractions for commercial bakery batches.

archetypes.name: Fraction Division via Reciprocal Multiplication (การหารเศษส่วนด้วยส่วนกลับ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing by a non-zero fraction is algebraically identical to multiplying by its reciprocal: Keep-Change-Flip.
mentalModel: 1. Retain the dividend fraction unchanged.
2. Invert the divisor fraction to form its multiplicative reciprocal.
3. Multiply numerators and denominators, simplifying common factors.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying directly straight across without inverting the divisor.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating number of garment cuts obtainable from a fractional fabric roll.
Determining syringe doses from fractional bulk medicinal vials.

archetypes.name: Fraction Addition with Common Denominators (การบวกเศษส่วนที่มีส่วนเท่ากัน)
archetypes.coreConcept: Fractions with identical unit partitions are combined by summing numerators over the preserved common denominator.
mentalModel: 1. Verify that both denominators are identical.
2. Sum numerators: a + b.
3. Keep the shared denominator unchanged.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / d + b / d = (a + b) / d

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding denominators together as well as numerators.

versatileDomains.description: Tracking cumulative highway paving progress across consecutive days.
Summing water volume increments in an irrigation ditch.

archetypes.name: Fraction Addition via Least Common Denominator (การบวกเศษส่วนส่วนไม่เท่ากันด้วย ค.ร.น.)
archetypes.coreConcept: Adding fractions with unequal denominators requires finding the least common denominator to scale terms into equivalent fractions.
mentalModel: 1. Compute the least common multiple of both denominators (LCD).
2. Multiply numerator and denominator of each fraction by the required factor.
3. Add the scaled numerators over the common LCD.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / b + c / d = (a*d + b*c) / (b * d)

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding top to top and bottom to bottom without finding a common denominator.

versatileDomains.description: Combining mass fractions of resin and carbon matrix in aerospace parts.
Aggregating volumetric cement and aggregate mix ratios.

archetypes.name: Mixed Number Subtraction with Denominator Regrouping (การลบจำนวนคละแบบกระจายหน่วย)
archetypes.coreConcept: Subtracting fractional values requiring decomposition of whole integer units into equivalent fractional parts. L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Adding instead of subtracting the fractional lengths (tag `c04-subtraction-inversion-on-regrouping`)'; the prompt shows the work as 'Line N: $...$' lines and the learner picks the first wrong line (answerSpec `choice` with `verify.flaw`; asking for the corrected value lets the learner just recompute, 06 §2.3).
mentalModel: 1. Express measurements as improper fractions or regrouped mixed units.
2. Subtract numerators over the common denominator.
3. Simplify resulting improper fraction or mixed number.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / d - b / d = (a - b) / d

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding instead of subtracting the fractional lengths.

versatileDomains.description: Cutting off specified lengths from structural architectural joists.
Trimming drainage PVC pipes during plumbing installation.

archetypes.name: Complex Fraction Compound Reduction (การลดรูปเศษส่วนซ้อน)
archetypes.coreConcept: Simplifying rational expressions where both numerator and denominator contain fractions: (a/b) / (c/d) = (ad) / (bc). L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Multiplying directly without inverting the denominator fraction (tag `c04-nested-fraction-inversion-slip`)'; the prompt shows the work as 'Line N: $...$' lines and the learner picks the first wrong line (answerSpec `choice` with `verify.flaw`; asking for the corrected value lets the learner just recompute, 06 §2.3).
mentalModel: 1. Identify the primary division bar separating numerator and denominator fractions.
2. Multiply the numerator fraction by the reciprocal of the denominator fraction.
3. Cancel common prime factors to reach canonical form.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying directly without inverting the denominator fraction.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating ratio of parallel branch conductances in DC circuits.
Evaluating quick liquidity asset ratios from financial balances.

archetypes.name: Fractional Coefficient Linear Equation Inversion (การแก้สมการเชิงเส้นสัมประสิทธิ์เศษส่วน)
archetypes.coreConcept: Isolating an unknown variable multiplied by a fraction by applying the reciprocal property of equality: (a/b)x = c <=> x = c * (b/a).
mentalModel: 1. Identify the fractional coefficient multiplying the unknown variable.
2. Multiply both sides of the equation by the reciprocal of the coefficient.
3. Simplify the product to isolate the unknown quantity.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying by the fraction directly rather than its reciprocal.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating total capacity of water treatment storage tanks.
Finding total syrup vat batch volume from fractional recipe requirements.

archetypes.name: Multi-Pipe Invariant Fractional Work Rate Model (แบบจำลองอัตราการทำงานเชิงเศษส่วนของท่อระบายน้ำ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Harmonic rate superposition where opposing filling and emptying rates yield net volumetric accumulation rate.
mentalModel: 1. Express filling rate as 1 / t_fill and emptying rate as 1 / t_drain.
2. Subtract draining rate from filling rate to obtain net rate: 1 / T.
3. Invert net fractional rate to determine total time to completely fill.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting elapsed times directly rather than combining rates harmonically.

versatileDomains.description: Sizing fill and drain cycles in continuous chemical synthesis reactors.
Balancing inflow and filtration cycling times in fish hatcheries.

archetypes.name: Multi-Stage Successive Fraction Allocation (การจัดสรรทรัพยากรแบบหักส่วนที่เหลือหลายขั้นตอน)
archetypes.coreConcept: Chained resource depletion models where fractions apply sequentially to remaining portions rather than initial totals.
mentalModel: 1. Calculate fraction remaining after first stage: 1 - f_1.
2. Multiply by fraction remaining after second stage: (1 - f_1) * (1 - f_2).
3. Set equal to known terminal residue and invert to solve for initial reserve.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding fractions together without taking the remainder into account.

versatileDomains.description: Back-calculating initial famine grain reserve from sequential humanitarian dispatches.
Auditing university research endowment reserves after sequential grant rounds.
